notes: All custom field writes use field-{number} IDs specific to Godspeed's Affinity org instance. Native enrichment fields use affinity-data- slug IDs. Dealroom fields are read-only and must never be written to.

core_attributes.note: These are core company record attributes written at record creation via create_organization — not field writes

native_enrichment_fields.note: These use affinity-data- slug IDs. Do not write to dealroom- versions of these fields.

custom_fields.note: These are custom fields created in Godspeed's Affinity org instance. IDs are confirmed and stable unless a field is deleted and recreated.

excluded_fields.note: These fields exist in Affinity but must never be written to by the plugin

leverage.label: Leverage
leverage.reason: Calculated Smart Field — Affinity computes automatically from Net Debt and LTM EBITDA. Absent from MCP schema.
